Evidence / CLM-015
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?2024-06-26

A dated list of unlicensed services, not a permanent status

01What does this evidence establish?

A 26 June 2024 circular of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) names 12 electronic wallets, entities or services as unlicensed by that authority on that date and prohibits banks and exchange businesses from dealing with them. Status under any other authority is not established here. Governor's Decision No. 23 of 2024 on domestic money-transfer activity carries the same date; the circular and the decision are separate instruments, and this record establishes no link between them.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The electronic wallets, entities and services named as unlicensed in a circular of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated 26 June 2024.

03Who or what does it apply to?

The 12 names or services listed in the circular; not the full set of licensed providers

04How current is it?

The circular is dated 26 June 2024. It should not be read as describing the status of any named service at a later date; later changes, including any licensing, are not tracked in this record.

05What this evidence does not establish

The unlicensed status applies to the circular's date and is not a 2026 status without newer evidence; the list does not identify which wallets are licensed, and it does not establish the status of these services under any other authority.

Limits of the measure

The source is a warning list of names declared unlicensed on its publication date; it records a regulatory declaration, not an observation of whether those services operated then or later.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

The names are taken from the text of the circular issued by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) on 26 June 2024 and recorded by name and date in this resource's internal source records; they are not reproduced here. A list of unlicensed names does not establish the complete set of licensed or operating providers.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
